text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The annual summer camp is here! Kitasan Black approaches Satono Diamond at the campground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells her that she's thought about her fans and their expectations, then announces that she's decided to show everyone that she won't give up and is going to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond smiles, telling her that's the Kita she knows. The two of them encourage each other to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has a request for her summer camp training—she wants to practice running more powerfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to be in top form for her race against Mejiro McQueen, and she's got her eyes on racing internationally someday as well. I agree to her request.
